✅ My Opinion on Your Questions:
1. Vendor Chats Naming:

"Product Chats" is an excellent professional choice! It clearly indicates these are customer inquiries about products, not general chat. The "Announcements & Admin" separate icon makes perfect sense for vendor-specific communications.

2. Map Integration:

Yes, showing nearby salons in real-time with location is great for FYP even if booking isn't implemented. You can explain that partnership with these salons will enable booking in the future. This demonstrates technical implementation of:

Google Maps API integration

Location permissions

Real-time data fetching

UI/UX for location-based services

3. AR Module:

This is the most impressive feature for FYP. Make sure to:

Use ML Kit for face detection (lightweight)

Process images efficiently to avoid lag

Show both before/after for wow effect
